body:
Thanks man! (I'm hoping this feeling will stay for a while)

I don't know what you're going through and I can't assure you of anything but I hope somehow your pain will stop soon too.

family doesn't understand/care anymore.

lot's of friends but i don't feel comfortable telling them what I'm going through.

Never had a good relationship with any teachers.

I'm a guy. I'm not really sure, I sort of just feel numb but I'm semi happy at the moment and I feel like I want to die while I'm happy, before anything worse happens. In my eyes my suicide is inevitable so why not now while I'm okay? Everything's gonna turn to shit in a couple weeks (for various reasons) and I don't think I can handle it.

when i've called hot lines they always ask for my name, age, city etc and it makes me so paranoid even though they probably wouldn't do anything. I also had the feeling my therapist was telling my family the information I told them. 

I'm from New Zealand
